judges: Independent general subagents; default model at dispatch, not pinned across the interrupted session. Scores are directional, not a controlled statistical comparison.
scope: CLI roleplay with fixture tools; no production provider API, latency, billed token, cost or cache measurements.
contextProxy: Sum of system+user+accumulated tool input/output character lengths at each modeled step. Excludes tool schemas, step instructions, assistant prose/reasoning, coding-harness context and provider caches.
scoring: Weighted category total recomputed by the repository rubric; advisory judge totals are retained verbatim. Pass also requires every category >=75, goalFulfillment >=85, complexityDiscipline >=80, would-use-daily and no fatal problems.
